一點心意，莫推辭。: A small token. Don't refuse it.
上回他也是這麼說的。: He said that last time too.
不知抬的是哪家的。: Whose household is that, I wonder.
且慢，先報個生辰。: Wait. First, the hour of your birth.
乾不乾？莫是濕的。: Is it dry? Not damp, is it?
人馬都乏了……: Men and horses, all worn out…
今日問卦的人真多。: So many asking for readings today.
今日就剩這幾筐了。: Only these few baskets left today.
你也坐，橫豎是等。: Sit down too. We're all waiting anyway.
你若無事，也坐下歇歇罷。: If you've nothing to do, sit and rest.
兄弟哪個鋪的？也在等差？: Which post are you from, brother? Waiting too?
兄弟，這一筐便宜給你。: Brother, this basket's cheap for you.
先生，我這趟買賣做得成麼？: Master, will this deal of mine come off?
先難後易，莫慌。: Hard first, easy after. Don't fret.
公文到底幾時下來？: When will the papers come down?
出了城，路就寬了。: Out of town the road gets wider.
前頭牛車多，當心些。: Lots of ox carts ahead. Careful.
十句裏有一句準就不錯。: Lucky if one word in ten comes true.
卦上說，過了這關就好。: The reading says: past this, all is well.
又一個問前程的。: Another one asking about his future.
又來了？這回問甚麼？: Back again? What is it this time?
又來了？這箱子碰不得。: Back again? Hands off the chest.
城門口稅重，這趟買賣做得成麼？: The gate tax is heavy. Will my deal come off?
城門口稅重，這趟還划得來麼？: With the gate tax so heavy, is the trip still worth it?
城門夜裏一關，就在這裏歇。: When the gate shuts at night, couriers rest here.
士大夫的命運，在我可否之間。: The fortunes of officials hang on my yes or no.
多日不見，一向可好？: Long time no see. Keeping well?
大哥，問問今年的生計？: Brother, ask about this year's living?
天不亮就該走了，差官還不出來。: We should have left before dawn. The official still hasn't come out.
天氣倒好，正好趕路。: Fine weather. Good for the road.
天黑前得趕到。: We must get there before dark.
好貨，進來瞧瞧。: Good wares. Come in and look.
娘子問姻緣，還是問子嗣？: Madam, is it marriage you ask about, or children?
娘子靠邊，莫碰著。: Madam, stand aside. Don't get hit.
娘子，這是遞鋪，閒人莫近。: Madam, this is the courier post. Keep away.
守著這箱子，動也不敢動。: Guarding this chest, I daren't move.
官人先行，轎子讓一讓。: After you, sir. The chairs will wait.
官人勒住，靠邊！: Rein in, sir! Keep to the side!
官人可是來催公文的？: Sir, have you come to hurry the papers?
官人若見著差官，替咱催一催。: Sir, if you see the officer, hurry him for us.
官人請坐，看個前程？: Please sit, sir. A look at your prospects?
官人還想問些甚麼？: What else would you ask, sir?
官人，挑一筐送到府上？: Sir, pick a basket, delivered to your house?
官人，看個前程？: Sir, a look at your prospects?
官衙裏的人，也來問他。: Even people from the office come to ask him.
客官進來看看。: Come in and have a look.
客官，看命？決疑？: Read your fate? Settle a doubt?
小哥兒，你也來算命？: Little one, here for a reading too?
山門不開，走旁門罷。: The main gate is shut. The side door, then.
師父也信這個？: You believe in this too, Master?
師父，這裏沒有齋飯。: Master, there's no alms food here.
慢起，莫顛著裏頭。: Lift gently. Don't jolt the one inside.
我這幾塊招牌：決疑、看命、神課。: My signs: settle doubts, read fates, divine lessons.
擠一擠，叫我也聽聽。: Make room, let me hear too.
相公還想問功名？: Still asking about the exams, sir?
看你這氣色，今年必有一番進益。: By your colour, you'll get ahead this year.
看你這氣色，今年必有進益。: By your colour, you'll get ahead this year.
看甚麼？公文還沒下來。: What are you staring at? The papers aren't out yet.
睡罷，醒了好趕路。: Let them sleep. They'll walk better for it.
神課上說：先難後易。: The lesson says: hard first, easy after.
神課，靈得很，來問一卦？: Divine lessons, they come true. A reading?
箱裏是遞往外地的公文。: The chest holds papers for the provinces.
聽先生的，錯不了。: Listen to him. You can't go wrong.
莫急，待我起一課。: Patience. Let me cast a reading.
讓開！牛車來了！: Out of the way! Ox cart!
貨到城門，稅就去了一半。: Reach the gate and half goes in tax.
趕在城門關前進城。: Into town before the gate shuts.
蹲久了，腳都麻了。: Squatted so long my feet are numb.
軍爺，問問幾時換防？: Soldier, ask when you'll be relieved?
這位相公，可要問問功名？: Young scholar, ask about the exams?
這價再公道不過。: As fair a price as there is.
這幾馱炭，進城賣給酒店。: This charcoal goes to the town's taverns.
這擔子越挑越重。: The load gets heavier every step.
這攤子挨著官衙，倒會挑地方。: Set up by the office: he knows where to sit.
這是甚麼好吃的？: What's this good thing to eat?
這箱公文，比人還金貴。: This chest of papers is worth more than we are.
這路也太窄了。: This road is far too narrow.
這車貨，夠牛受的。: A load like this is hard on the oxen.
這頭牛又犯倔了。: This ox is being stubborn again.
那匹白馬倒是自在。: That white horse has it easy.
靠邊，靠邊！: To the side, to the side!
馱炭的驢，也得歇歇腳。: Charcoal donkeys need a rest too.
